evidence:
Assigned row 33 only. Direct workbook reading establishes the bar at Quality Checks C34:D34: each criterion must state ONE full-credit bar, without enumerating requirements and then waiving them. The Internal Quality Checks E34 annotation permits reuse of a multi-step flow; current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md says independent outcomes still retain separate credit. I read every description in all five frozen judge files: render 1, constraints 1, functional 133, polish 4, visual 5; total 144, then compared the associated protocols and public rules. No internally contradictory full-credit bar was found.

Concrete source cases (paths below relative to the frozen task): tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 consistently requires one successful UI-created requisition/offer and independent-context readback; excluding advanced settlement at line25 does not waive creation, values or PENDING association. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:488,533,578 retain successful observed nonzero-relocation actions and absence of relocation settlement even when alternate ordinary records replace the shared P4 chain. The line533 fallback removes the second-generation-lineage prerequisite, not the obligation to save changed relocation and inspect financial records. hro_cancel at line587 expressly keeps historical-grant protection dependent on a completed revision witness even when direct approval supplies the rounding witness. hro_months at line596 owns elapsed-month selection and names equivalent 100-unit evidence; hro_equity_cap at line614 owns schedule/cap with an explicit equivalent 100-unit fallback while reserving odd-unit rounding for hro_cancel. These are defined evidence alternatives for the same owned outcome, not permissions to skip that outcome.

The common ownership clauses remain consistent: e.g. functional lines848-875 grade structured snapshot content/history against actual observed values and reserve arithmetic for separate criteria; lines992-1019 require the stated stale/refreshed-key/noninvalidating outcomes; lines1028,1037,1046 distinguish identical retry, overlapping-operation conflict and disjoint success without a chosen-winner requirement. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:11,19,53-65 permits simpler independent setup and reuse of measured facts but grants no unobserved outcome. tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:32 permits request interruption or a genuinely invalid alternate field only to establish the same retained editable date and successful retry; it does not grant credit when tooling prevents observation. Lines41 and50 retain distinct stale-editor and uncertain-response recovery requirements. Each visual description at tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:24-89 has exactly one score5 anchor followed by lower anchors, with no optional substitute for that top bar.

Adversarial source reasoning: an app that disables revision/rescission altogether cannot use the relocation absence clauses to pass: successful actions and fresh payment observations remain mandatory. An app that only hides the failing operation, drops retained form values, or returns a new operation after an uncertain commit fails the explicit Polish bar. Conversely a conforming UI using native dates, alternative labels, generated IDs, or no zero-valued ledger rows remains allowed by the explicit representation/zero-row exceptions; these exceptions do not waive the owned behavior. No row33 false-pass or false-fail counterexample survived the complete wording. This does not assess independent coverage, hidden requirements or runtime feasibility beyond their effect on the assigned self-consistency bar.

Exact binding: all 71 frozen task/rule files and all 14 current engine/policy files matched the manifest. Functional judge SHA256 49c966b92b91a70e6e2e89d3eb2c1a16d80029a743a3df894265deacf4eeec49; functional prompt 9b8ab2dd2ba5e44d5f4d894839ecc9c7ab82a5f18bc618e5a91d9a5cffb36048; workbook 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f. Additional hashes and counts are recorded in per-row-review/evidence/33/source-binding.json. Raw evidence index was hash-checked but no runtime claim is derived from its presence. This is a static-source Pass for row33 only; no new Docker/provider work, configured judge, Oracle, target-model score, private checker execution, timing measurement or hosted result is claimed. Required runtime evidence for other rows remains outside this finding and is not waived.
counterexample: Adversarial attempts were reasoned from the exact criterion text, not executed: a dead relocation handler cannot pass the required success controls (functional lines488/533/578); a hidden input-loss implementation cannot pass retained editable values plus successful retry (polish lines32/41/50). Conforming native-date, generated-ID and omitted-zero-row variants remain expressly accepted. No confirmed self-inconsistency counterexample.
